## The problem and user

Who needs the system, what should it do, and how will you know it works?

## Environment and design

Record the relevant operating system, Python version, input/output design, data
flow, state model, and dependencies without publishing device or network secrets.

## Important code

Include short excerpts only when they help explain a decision. Link to the full
teacher-approved source when appropriate.

## Hardware evidence, if used

Separate software results from GPIO voltage, circuit, and load-interface checks.

## Fault, revision, and conclusion

Explain the evidence that exposed one bug or design problem, the revision, and
the remaining limitation.
